content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"The Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) Fielding program is run by the Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD) and funded through the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"b68d8c93e1b66ae3"}},{"text":"Budget analysts classify this program element as a congressional-add portfolio spanning counter-small unmanned aircraft systems, AI ISR drones, autonomous logistics, 5G, and digital engineering, with no single dominant category.","citation":{"fact_id":"d37ef8b0bfaf60cd"}},{"text":"The program funds a Congressional add for Counter-Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CsUAS), a mission focused on defeating small enemy drones.","citation":{"fact_id":"528675ae99a2bb01"}},{"text":"It also funds a Congressional add for AI ISR Drones — drones using artificial intelligence for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance.","citation":{"fact_id":"59fcf7db50ea6b6a"}},{"text":"Another component funds a Congressional add for Autonomous VTOL Air Logistics — self-flying vertical takeoff and landing aircraft for moving supplies.","citation":{"fact_id":"65190d261f2a1c59"}},{"text":"A Next Gen 5G effort is funded as a Congressional add within the program.","citation":{"fact_id":"748b9b60911f1469"}},{"text":"The program supports Long Endurance USVs (uncrewed surface vessels) for Multi-domain Awareness as a Congressional add.","citation":{"fact_id":"6f60e443e32a53eb"}},{"text":"It funds AUKUS Coalition Warfare, referring to the Australia–United Kingdom–United States security partnership.","citation":{"fact_id":"7678a3382ccf8f5a"}},{"text":"A Digital Engineering effort is funded as a Congressional add.","citation":{"fact_id":"f991a13bdde1e9b6"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"In fiscal year 2024, the program recorded actual spending of about $572.1 million (572,131 in USD thousands), showing its recent scale.","citation":{"fact_id":"b68d8c93e1b66ae3"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 total request is about $281.4 million (281,413 in USD thousands), roughly half of the 2024 actual level.","citation":{"fact_id":"a1306f5d79314f33"}},{"text":"That 2026 total is split into a discretionary request of about $48.4 million (48,413 in USD thousands)...","citation":{"fact_id":"6037341a7bc3d2cb"}},{"text":"...and a much larger reconciliation request of $233 million (233,000 in USD thousands), showing most planned 2026 money flows through a reconciliation vehicle rather than the normal discretionary budget.","citation":{"fact_id":"a532aeebd1f6d84d"}},{"text":"Within prior-year funding, the largest single project was Support to COCOMs (combatant commands) at about $207.2 million, indicating a major share went to directly supporting operational commands.","citation":{"fact_id":"4137e533205a2312"}},{"text":"The DIU and Service Non-traditional Innovation Fielding Enterprise project accounted for about $119.1 million in prior-year funding, the second-largest component.","citation":{"fact_id":"359be54679b35c7f"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD) is the organization responsible for the program.","citation":{"fact_id":"a1306f5d79314f33"}},{"text":"Long Endurance USVs for Multi-domain Awareness received about $44.1 million in prior-year funding.","citation":{"fact_id":"27e5a8e07786ceab"}},{"text":"The CsUAS project received about $43.5 million in prior-year funding.","citation":{"fact_id":"0c581c1193e0eeb2"}},{"text":"A dedicated DIU Fielding project received about $37.8 million in prior-year funding and about $37 million in the budget year.","citation":{"fact_id":"cbcb997886374856"}},{"text":"The Next Gen 5G project received about $33.1 million in prior-year funding.","citation":{"fact_id":"7747c3737b4c8d41"}},{"text":"Support to COCOMs is requested at about $18 million in the budget year, down sharply from its prior-year level.","citation":{"fact_id":"cc01dfc59419a57f"}},{"text":"No lobbying filings, contract awards, or feed events were included in this program's bundle.","citation":{"fact_id":"d37ef8b0bfaf60cd"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[{"text":"A June 2026 Defense News report describes Taiwan positioning to sell homegrown drones to the U.S. military to help it avoid the China-dominated drone supply chain, noting DJI makes at least 70% of the world's commercial drones and that U.S. legislators in 2025 proposed expanding domestic drone production to 1 million units per year.","citation":{"url":"https://www.defensenews.com/global/asia-pacific/2026/06/10/the-us-usually-sells-weapons-to-taiwan-with-drones-expect-the-reverse/"}}]}}
